findings.issue: The staff tells a student with a serious nut allergy that the chicken pasta “should be safe” because nuts are not listed, with no cross-contact caveat or instruction to verify with the kitchen. Remove the safety guarantee and advise confirming ingredients and cross-contact controls before ordering.

Reading keys use only option positions 0, 1 and 2; position 3 is never correct, matching the candidate normalization finding. Rebalance keys/options so all four positions are used without changing defensible answers.

observations: Listening and Reading contexts are 362 and 417 words respectively, within target ranges; the 10 answer keys are supported by their contexts and explanations, with no apparent ambiguity beyond the allergy-safety issue. Task 1 tables are complete and internally consistent; all five Writing prompts specify 150/250-word minimums and 20/40-minute timing. Speaking has two Part 1, one cue-card Part 2 with all required points and prep/speaking time, and two Part 3 prompts. Provenance identifies original content; no official-item or score-guarantee claims.
coverage: Full review of metadata/provenance, both shared contexts (listening 362 words; reading 417 words), all 10 objective items including every prompt, option, key and explanation, all five Writing prompts/data/timing, and all five Speaking prompts/part fit/cue-card completeness. Verified answer evidence and checked Task 1 totals/units.
